tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: the design canvas every page sits on. Pair with the dot grid (`canvas-dot` at `dot-pitch`).

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid only. Never text, never borders.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Translucent background of the sticky top bar once the page scrolls, with a 10px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Frames and objects placed on the canvas: cards, panels, chips, inputs, sticky top-bar menus.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders of frames, cards, chips and dividers. Decorative edges only (about 1.4:1): a control that must be found by its border also needs `ink-2` text or an icon.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headlines and line-art strokes. On `canvas` and `surface` (15.4:1 and 17.9:1 light; 15.4:1 and 13.9:1 dark). Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy under headlines, ledes, metadata, nav links. On `canvas` and `surface` (5.9 to 7.7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Faint marks only: secondary lines in illustrations, step numbers that sit beside a readable label. Fails as text (2.5:1 on `canvas` light, 3.4:1 dark), so never use it for words someone has to read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection blue: the thing you are working on. Selection frames, handles, focus rings, the active step, links, the one highlighted word in a headline. As text on `canvas` (4.9:1 light, 6.6:1 dark) and `surface`. One accent moment per view.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Translucent selection tint behind selected rows or a dragged area. Not a text background (use `progress-soft`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (dimension tags, filled selected chips): 5.7:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: component
tokens.usage: The ◇ component glyph and component labels, borrowed from design tools. On `surface` passes (5.0:1 light); as small text on `canvas` it misses in light (4.3:1): use `component-ink` there.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Spec redlines and measurement tags (spacing, size, radius) only. As text on `surface` it misses in light (4.3:1), and white on a `measure` fill misses (4.3:1 light, 2.9:1 dark). Fix proposed: tags with dark `on-accent` text in dark, and #c4285f for light (5.5:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success lines and fills in illustrations (the rising chart, the release badge fill). As small text it misses in light (4.3:1 on `surface`, 3.7:1 on `canvas`): use `success-ink` for words.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Warm light from the lightbulb (radial glow and the lit bulb fill). Illustration only, never text or UI.

tokens.name: world
tokens.usage: The warm daylight wash when a story leaves the canvas for the real world (the last story chapter). Illustration only.

tokens.name: sticky-yellow
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper (the default and the winning idea). Text on it is `sticky-ink` (12.3:1 light, 10.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: sticky-pink
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper. Text on it is `sticky-ink` (9.5:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: sticky-green
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, also used for test-result notes. Text on it is `sticky-ink` (11.5:1 light, 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: sticky-lilac
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper. Text on it is `sticky-ink` (10.1:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: sticky-ink
tokens.usage: Handwriting on sticky notes, in both themes (stickies stay paper-colored in dark).

tokens.name: sticky-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow color under sticky notes only (see `shadow-sticky`).

tokens.name: role-pm
tokens.usage: Product manager: cursor arrow, name tag and chat bubble; avatar fill for the same role. White `on-role` text misses (4.2:1 light, 3.0:1 dark): see `on-role`.

tokens.name: role-research
tokens.usage: Researcher: cursor, name tag, chat, avatar. White text 5.0:1 light, 3.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: role-design
tokens.usage: Designer: cursor, name tag, chat, avatar. White text 5.7:1 light, 3.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: role-eng
tokens.usage: Engineer: cursor, name tag, chat, avatar. White text 5.7:1 light, 3.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: role-you
tokens.usage: The viewer's own “You” cursor tag that follows the pointer. White text 4.8:1 light, 3.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-role
tokens.usage: Text on role fills (name tags, chat bubbles, avatar initials). Kept white from the source; in dark it misses on every role (2.9 to 3.8:1). Fix proposed: #0b0d12 in dark (5.2 to 6.4:1).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Success words: the “Shipped” status pill, positive deltas. On `canvas`, `surface` and `success-soft` (5.0 to 5.9:1 light, 7.4 to 9.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Background of the “Shipped” status pill; text on it is `success-ink`.

tokens.name: progress-soft
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Background of the “In progress” status pill; text on it is `accent` (4.8:1 light, 5.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: component-ink
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Component purple for small text on `canvas` and on `component-soft` (5.3 to 5.4:1 light): the “In review” pill and ◇ labels on the canvas.

tokens.name: component-soft
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Background of the “In review” status pill; text on it is `component-ink`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Words that need attention soon (“At risk”, “Due this week”). On `surface` and `warning-soft` (4.8 to 5.3:1 light, 7.2 to 8.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Background of the “At risk” status pill; text on it is `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Blocked work and errors. On `surface` and `danger-soft` (4.9 to 5.5:1 light, 6.3 to 6.7:1 dark). Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Design Hub addition. Background of the “Blocked” status pill and error notices; text on it is `danger`.

tokens.name: app-bezel
tokens.usage: Illustration only: device bezels and the rugged handheld's body. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: app-bg
tokens.usage: Illustration only: screen background of the example EMM console and device screens.

tokens.name: app-card
tokens.usage: Illustration only: cards inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-ink
tokens.usage: Illustration only: text inside the example console (on `app-bg` and `app-card`).

tokens.name: app-muted
tokens.usage: Illustration only: secondary text inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-line
tokens.usage: Illustration only: borders and progress tracks inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-primary
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the example console's brand (buttons, progress, active nav). Teal, so it never competes with `accent`.

tokens.name: app-sun
tokens.usage: Illustration only: chart bars and highlights inside example screens.

tokens.name: app-mint
tokens.usage: Illustration only: soft icon tiles inside example screens.

tokens.name: app-coral
tokens.usage: Illustration only: soft icon tiles inside example screens.

tokens.name: app-lilac
tokens.usage: Illustration only: soft icon tiles inside example screens.

tokens.name: app-side
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the example console's dark sidebar.

tokens.name: app-critical
tokens.usage: Illustration only: failure states inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-critical-soft
tokens.usage: Illustration only: failure card background inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-success
tokens.usage: Illustration only: fixed and enrolled states inside example screens.

tokens.name: app-success-soft
tokens.usage: Illustration only: fixed card background inside the example console.

tokens.name: app-warn
tokens.usage: Illustration only: warning icon inside the example console.

tokens.name: rugged
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the safety-yellow bumper of the rugged handheld.

tokens.name: editor-bg
tokens.usage: Code editor background (always dark, both themes).

tokens.name: editor-bar
tokens.usage: Code editor title bar.

tokens.name: editor-text
tokens.usage: Code text and file name on `editor-bg`.

tokens.name: editor-dim
tokens.usage: Punctuation and line numbers on `editor-bg` (decorative; 3.6:1).

tokens.name: editor-key
tokens.usage: Code keywords (export, function, return).

tokens.name: editor-fn
tokens.usage: Function and property names; the typing caret.

tokens.name: editor-attr
tokens.usage: JSX attribute names.

tokens.name: editor-str
tokens.usage: Strings.

tokens.name: editor-tag
tokens.usage: JSX tag names.

families.sans: "Funnel Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.hand: Caveat, "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", "Comic Sans MS", cursive
families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Funnel Display, tight leading and negative tracking. Sizes are the desktop maximum of a fluid clamp(); each usage names the clamp.

styles.name: display-cta
styles.usage: One closing call to action per page. clamp(3.6rem, 13vw, 11rem).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: We turn a spark into a product
styles.usage: The page's opening headline, inside a selection frame. Max width 13ch. clamp(2.7rem, 7.4vw, 7.2rem).

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section titles under a frame label. clamp(2.4rem, 5.6vw, 5rem).

styles.name: display-statement
styles.sample: Fall in love with the problem first.
styles.usage: Principles and pull statements, one per line item. clamp(2rem, 5.4vw, 4.8rem).

styles.name: title-chapter
styles.usage: Story chapter titles and page titles inside the app. clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.4rem).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the logo mark in the top bar.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Funnel Sans for everything people read in sentences.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: We are the product design team: researchers, UX and visual designers, and prototypers.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or section title, in `ink-2`, max 54ch. clamp(1.0625rem, 1.3vw, 1.25rem).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We frame the problem as a question and bring product, engineering, support and research into the room.
styles.usage: Running text, in `ink-2` under a title or `ink` when it stands alone. Max 42 to 56ch.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Retry all 298 at once, or in batches?
styles.usage: Card body copy on phones, comments, table cells.

groups.name: Hand
groups.note: Caveat: the team's own voice, written on the canvas. Short asides, never paragraphs.

styles.name: hand-note
styles.usage: Margin notes beside statements and CTAs, in `accent`, lowercase. clamp(1.4rem, 2.2vw, 1.9rem).

styles.name: hand-sticky
styles.usage: Text on sticky notes, in `sticky-ink`, two short lines at most.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono for the tool's own chrome: labels, tags, specs, code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and step labels, uppercase, `ink-2` with the number in `accent`.

styles.name: frame-label
styles.usage: Frame labels above sections and frames, `ink-2` with the # in `accent`.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Component tags (chips), deliverable lists, dimension tags.

spacing.note: 4px steps, taken from the values the page uses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: selection handles sit 4 to 5px outside the frame.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and tags; vertical padding in compact pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; padding inside sticky notes.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter on every screen; gap between cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Card padding on large screens; gap between nav links.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between a hero frame and the text under it (min).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of cards; section header to content (min).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section header to content (max); hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page section on desktop. clamp(88px, 14vw, 180px).

radius.note: Frames are nearly square, chips are slightly soft, actions are pills.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Cards that act as frames on the canvas (capability, tool and person cards).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Dimension tags under a selection, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Component tags, cursor name tags, the skip link.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels inside illustrations and app-like blocks: comment cards, code editors, the AI panel, browser frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the theme switch, status pills, prompt bars.

shadow.note: The canvas is flat: borders separate things. Shadows are for paper on top of it.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky notes only.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the top bar once the page scrolls.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: Thickens the accent border of a hovered or selected card to a crisp 1.5px.

stroke.note: Line art is drawn, not filled. Widths are in the illustration's own units (a 1200 × 800 stage).

tokens.name: stroke-ink
tokens.usage: Main outlines of line art (objects, cards, people), in `ink`.

tokens.name: stroke-accent
tokens.usage: The one meaningful line in a scene (the filament, a lasso, a highlight loop), in `accent`.

tokens.name: stroke-ui
tokens.usage: UI icons (48px grid) and wireframe boxes, in `ink` or `ink-2`.

tokens.name: stroke-soft
tokens.usage: Connectors, chart axes and secondary lines, in `ink-3`.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders of frames and cards, in `hairline`.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar; sticky story stages start below it.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; the canvas runs edge to edge.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the canvas dot grid.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Size of a selection handle square (1.5px `accent` border, `surface` fill).

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Longest line for ledes and body copy.
